_note: This file is a constants-only module with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines three module-level variables used by Triton kernels in the UMA model.
constants_BLOCK_C: BLOCK_C = 128 — block size for channel vectorization in Triton kernels; must be a power of 2
constants_GRID_E_STRIDE: GRID_E_STRIDE = 2048 — fixed grid size for edge dimension grid-stride loop in Triton kernels
constants_M_TO_L_GATHER_IDX: M_TO_L_GATHER_IDX = [0, 5, 1, 3, 8, 6, 2, 4, 7] — permutation indices for M-major to L-major ordering used in NodeToEdgeWignerPermuteFunction backward pass
